Start the project in the background. Pause the video, type it yourself, then continue.

Step six. Why did the A P I restart? Let's read its logs, like docker logs from lesson five, but by service name.
Docker compose logs A P I. There's an error: connection refused on port fifty four thirty two. And then, later, Uvicorn running.
Here's what happened. Both containers started at almost the same time. The A P I tried to connect while Postgres was still starting, got connection refused, and crashed.
Then restart unless stopped started it again, and this time the database was ready. Uvicorn running. What a relief!
This happens a lot in real projects: an app starts faster than its database. A restart policy is the simplest fix.
